theorem QOU.MathlibExt.RepresentationCharacter.card_le_card_conjClasses_of_orthogonal {k : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [Field k] [Group G] [Fintype G] [Invertible ↑(Fintype.card G)] [DecidableRel IsConj] {ι : Type u_5} [Fintype ι] (χ : ι → G → k) (hcf : ∀ (i : ι), χ i ∈ GroupAlgebraCenter.classFunctions k G) (hoff : ∀ (i j : ι), i ≠ j → ((charForm k G) (χ i)) (χ j) = 0) (hdiag : ∀ (i : ι), ((charForm k G) (χ i)) (χ i) ≠ 0) :
Fintype.card ι ≤ Fintype.card (ConjClasses G)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.RepresentationCharacter.charForm_charOf {k : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} {W : Type u_4} [Field k] [Group G] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module k W] [Fintype G] [Invertible ↑(Fintype.card G)] [Module.Free k V] [Module.Finite k V] [Module.Free k W] [Module.Finite k W] (ρV : Representation k G V) (ρW : Representation k G W) :
((charForm k G) (charOf ρV)) (charOf ρW) = ↑(Module.finrank k ↥(homG ρV ρW))

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.RepresentationCharacter.charForm_apply (k : Type u_1) (G : Type u_2) [Field k] [Group G] [Fintype G] [Invertible ↑(Fintype.card G)] (f₁ f₂ : G → k) :
((charForm k G) f₁) f₂ = ⅟↑(Fintype.card G) • ∑ g : G, f₁ g⁻¹ * f₂ g

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.RepresentationCharacter.homG_eq_bot {k : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} {W : Type u_4} [Field k] [Group G] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module k W] {ρV : Representation k G V} {ρW : Representation k G W} (hV : ∀ (p : Submodule k V), (∀ (g : G), ∀ v ∈ p, (ρV g) v ∈ p) → p = ⊥ ∨ p = ⊤) (hW : ∀ (p : Submodule k W), (∀ (g : G), ∀ w ∈ p, (ρW g) w ∈ p) → p = ⊥ ∨ p = ⊤) (hno : ∀ (e : V ≃ₗ[k] W), ¬∀ (g : G) (v : V), e ((ρV g) v) = (ρW g) (e v)) :

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.RepresentationCharacter.charPairing_eq_finrank_homG {k : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} {W : Type u_4} [Field k] [Group G] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module k W] [Fintype G] [Invertible ↑(Fintype.card G)] [Module.Free k V] [Module.Finite k V] [Module.Free k W] [Module.Finite k W] (ρV : Representation k G V) (ρW : Representation k G W) :
⅟↑(Fintype.card G) • ∑ g : G, charOf ρV g⁻¹ * charOf ρW g = ↑(Module.finrank k ↥(homG ρV ρW))

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.RepresentationCharacter.mem_homG_iff {k : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} {W : Type u_4} [Field k] [Group G] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module k W] {ρV : Representation k G V} {ρW : Representation k G W} {f : V →ₗ[k] W} :

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.RepresentationCharacter.average_charOf {k : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [Field k] [Group G] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [Fintype G] [Invertible ↑(Fintype.card G)] [Module.Finite k V] (ρ : Representation k G V) :

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.RepresentationCharacter.charOf_linHom {k : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} {W : Type u_4} [Field k] [Group G] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module k W] [Module.Free k V] [Module.Finite k V] [Module.Free k W] [Module.Finite k W] (ρV : Representation k G V) (ρW : Representation k G W) (g : G) :
charOf (ρV.linHom ρW) g = charOf ρV g⁻¹ * charOf ρW g

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.RepresentationCharacter.linHom_comp {k : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} {W : Type u_4} [Field k] [Group G] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module k W] [Module.Free k V] [Module.Finite k V] (ρV : Representation k G V) (ρW : Representation k G W) (g : G) :
(ρV.linHom ρW) g ∘ₗ ↑(dualTensorHomEquiv k V W) = ↑(dualTensorHomEquiv k V W) ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (ρV.dual g) (ρW g)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.RepresentationCharacter.charOf_conj {k : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} {V : Type u_3} [Field k] [Group G] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] (ρ : Representation k G V) (g h : G) :
